speaker: Doctor
text: The bilirubin results show a significant indirect (unconjugated) elevation at 15.4 mg/dL with normal direct levels, which is consistent with jaundice. Given the infant is 2 weeks old and exclusively breastfed, this pattern strongly suggests Breast Milk Jaundice rather than breast milk failure or biliary atresia (which would show conjugated hyperbilirubinemia). Please confirm if the stools have ever appeared pale or clay-colored to definitively rule out biliary obstruction before I finalize the diagnosis.
